title: They Were Caught ‘Doing The Deed’ Outside Popeyes
description:
Drivers in Vero Beach, Florida were shocked when they drove by their local Popeyes restaurant to see two people on top of each other. Finally, the couple caught the attention of the police, who responded immediately. Arnold Oneal Mackey and April Marie White’s day of drinking quickly turned into something else when they spotted the perfect spot to hang out — a public sidewalk in front of a fried chicken restaurant. Mackey and White tried denying what was going on, but the responding officer had seen it all. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
